title: Keeping the Red Red: measurement tools, crawler, calibration script and data
description:
Paper sources, a dependency-free PHP library that reads the embedded ICC profile of a JPEG, PNG or WebP file and measures the colour shift when the profile is ignored (ΔE76 in CIELAB), a polite crawler that measures product images over live stores through their public catalogues, a WebP quality calibration script, a synthetic Display P3 profile for validation, and the data of the October 2026 crawl of 26 stores.

Code under the MIT licence; paper sources and data under CC BY 4.0.
